subject: Request: Field Research Consortium — pro-bono compute credits & trial extension
messages:
From: Sophie Martin <sophie@mapaid.org>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dr. Ahmed El‑Sayed <ahmed.elsayed@univ-nile.edu>, procurement@mapaid.org
Date: Fri, 10 Aug 2028 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Pilot request — cross-site field research (compute credits + extension)

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the helpful demo last month. MapAid's Field Research Consortium is preparing a multi-site pilot in three North African communities focused on offline mapping and humanitarian needs classification. The work is time-sensitive — heavy batch embeddings and nightly retraining from mobile-collected telemetry — and we are already bumping into our trial limits.

Two asks:
- A two-month trial extension (we need sustained access through Oct 2028) so the field teams can complete the annotation sweep and evaluation.
- A one-time pro-bono credit allocation of $10,000 worth of compute to cover heavy retrain/embedding runs and evaluation reruns.

Attached: short pilot proposal (MapAid_proposal.pdf) and the IRB-style ethics letter from our university partner (ethics_letter_signed.pdf). Procurement is looped (procurement@mapaid.org) in case there's any paperwork.

This is a public-interest project; we will acknowledge Redwood in outreach materials and can provide a short case study if useful. Happy to jump on a quick call if it helps.

Appreciate any flexibility here — the teams are very metalimited in the field and the research has real time windows.

Best,

Sophie Martin
Program Director, MapAid Collective
sophie@mapaid.org
+44 7700 900111

Attachments: MapAid_proposal.pdf (7 pages), ethics_letter_signed.pdf (2 pages)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie@mapaid.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Aug 2028 11:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot request — cross-site field research (compute credits + extension)

Hi Sophie — thanks for the detailed note and the materials. This sounds like the kind of public-interest pilot we'd like to support.

I can provision a two-month extension to your trial sandbox while we sort the pro-bono allocation, but I'll need approval from my manager and a quick sign-off from finance/legal on terms for the $10k credit (we usually route those as promotional credits tied to an MOU).

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll escalate internally and share the proposal.
2) Can procurement confirm the organization legal name and billing contact for an MOU? (procurement@mapaid.org)
3) If you're able to sign a short MOU (we can do DocuSign), we can issue the credit within 3 business days of countersignature.

Looping in Marissa (CC) to help with approvals and Evelyn (manager) if we need exception routing.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Thanks for the context, Ben. I've reviewed the proposal and the ethics letter — this is a strong public-interest ask and fits our PR/CS criteria for pro-bono support.

Finance/legal check list for a $10k promotional credit:
- Issue promotional credit tied to org hub id (not an individual key).
- Standard MOU limited to credit value, use case summary, and publicity permission. No PII ingest exceptions requested; they confirm data minimization in the ethics letter.
- SOC2 evidence not required for pilot-level promotional credits, but procurement may request a Data Processing Addendum — we can supply our standard DPA.

Priyom — can you prepare the promotional credit code terms and the MOU template? If possible, mark this as a charitable grant so accounting can route it to the CSR ledger.

Procurement@mapaid.org — please reply with the legal entity name for the MOU and the preferred signatory.

If all aligns, I can approve the 60-day extension immediately and authorize $10k in promo credits to be issued upon countersignature.

Marissa Cole
